tool.title: Moorkyz Directory Cleaner
tool.summary: Keep, move or archive files using patterns, creation dates and size limits. Preview every change first.
tool.catalogDescription: Bring order to a crowded downloads folder without turning cleanup into a leap of faith. Combine filename patterns, creation dates and size limits to keep what matters, move matching files or archive the rest. Review a non-mutating preview before explicitly confirming changes, and keep a recoverable receipt afterward. Use the downloadable script or an opt-in local workspace; nothing is permanently deleted or silently overwritten.
tool.description: A local file organizer available as both a web-service workspace and a downloadable script. Match filename or relative-path patterns, combine creation-before/after and size-smaller/larger conditions, then Keep, Move or Delete to archive. Keep rules win; otherwise the first match applies, and unmatched files remain untouched. Nothing is permanently deleted or overwritten.
useCases: Keep important documents while archiving old or tiny temporary files.
Move matching photos or downloads into another folder without overwriting existing files.
Find large files created before a chosen date, review the exact plan and archive only after confirmation.

setup.title: Use the downloadable script
setup.text: Requires Node.js 22+. Download the complete script ZIP from Tool or Workspace, extract it and download your settings from the rule editor. Preview does not change files.

setup.title: Apply a reviewed script preview
setup.text: Read preview.json and use its actual ID. Delete always puts files into an archive. The exact source snapshot is revalidated before any changes.

setup.title: Or start the local web service
setup.text: From this repository, run the service in its own terminal. It binds only to 127.0.0.1:8766; no account or installation runs automatically.

setup.title: Enable the portal connection
setup.text: In another terminal, opt in and bind the portal to loopback. Connect in Workspace, preview the files and type the exact confirmation. Both local-service connections are independent and off by default.
